HOME_PAGE.HERO_SUBTITLE: Turn CSV bank statements into clear stats. Everything stays in your browser.

GO_OFFLINE.TITLE: Go offline (optional)
GO_OFFLINE.DESCRIPTION: Open the Stats page, then disconnect from the internet for extra peace of mind.

ADD_FILES.TITLE: Add your files
ADD_FILES.DESCRIPTION: Drop CSV statements or a whole folder. Your bank is detected automatically.

VIEW_STATS.TITLE: Explore your stats
VIEW_STATS.DESCRIPTION: See your balance, cashflow and spending by category across all selected files.

OPEN_SOURCE.TITLE: Open source
OPEN_SOURCE.DESCRIPTION: The full source code is public, so anyone can verify that your data never leaves your device.

DROP_ZONE.DROP_TIP: Tip: Drop files anywhere to add them

DEVICE.TITLE: Device settings
DEVICE.PERSIST_ON: Files will be kept in your browser storage until manually deleted.
DEVICE.PERSIST_OFF: Files will be automatically cleared when you close the tab or app.

STORAGE.TITLE: Storage details
STORAGE.NO_FORMATS: No custom formats yet. Set one up from an unsupported file on the stats page.
STORAGE.NO_RULES: No category rules yet. Change a category in the transactions table on the stats page.
STORAGE.CONFIRM_DELETE_FILES: Are you sure you want to delete all files?
STORAGE.CONFIRM_DELETE_FORMATS: Are you sure you want to delete all custom formats? Files read with them will need to be set up again.
STORAGE.CONFIRM_DELETE_RULES: Are you sure you want to delete all category rules, rule sets and changed categories?
STORAGE.CONFIRM_DELETE_ALL: Are you sure you want to delete all data? This deletes all files, custom formats and category rules.
